data.name: Survival Of Runt
data.detailed_description:
Open-World PvPvE Zombie Survival Shooter

In the near future, the utopia controlled entirely by the super-intelligent AI 'Lazarus' collapsed overnight.

The majority of humanity, implanted with neural cyberchips, lost their free will and mutated into monstrous beings that hunt survivors.

Only the 'Runts'—those discarded and ignored because they were never connected to the AI network—miraculously survived.

Will you rebuild hope in a shattered world, or completely tear down the illusion of the AI utopia?

Game Modes

1. DEADZONE : Extreme Survival Competition

An intense survival battlefield where you must endure 30 to 40 minutes amidst the relentless threats of mutants and rival survivors.

Upon death, 2,000 Time Tokens will be deducted.

  • Choice of Will : Select your victory condition upon entering the battlefield.

  • Order : Survive as the Final 4 to earn 8,000 Time Tokens.

  • Chaos : Survive as the Last 1 standing to claim a massive 24,000 Time Tokens.

  • Regardless of your 'Choice of Will', you can freely form alliances or betray others at any time during the match.

  • Loot Preservation : If you survive until the end, you can save 1 key item in your stash. Stored items can be brought into Conquest or future Deadzone matches as strategic assets.

  • Zombie Resurrection : When a human survivor dies, they are immediately reborn as a Zombie Player. Hunt living survivors to recover your lost Time Tokens.

  • Story Quests : Track the traces of the super-AI 'Lazarus' and uncover the hidden truth behind the collapse.

2. CONQUEST : Open-World Survival & Faction Warfare

An open-world mode where you explore the wild, gather resources, build your fortress, and conquer every territory on the map.

  • Freeform Survival & Building : Enjoy diverse survival activities including resource harvesting, equipment crafting, and modular base construction.

  • Territory Conquest : Establish your faction and capture territorial hubs. The ultimate goal is to seize all zones and achieve total world domination. (Capturing consumes Time Tokens)

  • Weekly Quests : Complete missions from NPC survivor settlements to secure 'Time Tokens', the vital resource for Deadzone entries.

Game Features

  • Intelligent Zombie AI & Limb Dismemberment : Mutants scale walls, crawl across ceilings, and launch ambush attacks. Features precise gore dismemberment where heads, arms, and legs are realistically severed in combat.

  • Interactive AI & Local TTS Voice Synthesis : Advanced AI and low-latency TTS engines drive real-time, dynamic NPC voice interactions and environmental responses.

  • Modular Building Destruction : All structures in the world can be destroyed module by module, allowing you to blast open walls and carve out new tactical routes.


"Now, the desperate struggle of the Runts to survive begins."

data.short_description: An open-world PvPvE zombie survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a zombie player to hunt down survivors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12600K / AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is set in a zombie survival environment and includes violent depictions such as bloodstains and dismemberment.
It does not contain any content related to sexual assault, non-consensual sexual acts, explicit sexual behavior, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
Players who are sensitive to violent content are advised to take this into consideration when playing the game.
